subject: general
question: The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act, 2005 (MGNREGA) provides a legal guarantee for how many days of employment per year to every rural household in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 days**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), enacted in 2005, provides a legal guarantee of **100 days of wage employment in a financial year** to every rural household in India.
 
• Under the scheme, adult members of a rural household willing to do unskilled manual work can apply for employment.
 
• MGNREGA aims to enhance livelihood security in rural areas by providing employment opportunities and creating durable assets such as roads, irrigation facilities, and other infrastructure.
 
• It is implemented by the Ministry of Rural Development, and the wages are paid directly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries to ensure transparency.
 
• The scheme also promotes social inclusion by providing employment opportunities to marginalized sections, including women and Scheduled Castes/Scheduled Tribes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MGNREGA**

 
 
• MGNREGA is one of the largest social security and public works programs globally, addressing poverty and unemployment in rural areas.
 
• The scheme empowers rural households, ensures gender parity, and improves the economic condition of marginalized communities.
 
• It also focuses on sustainable development by promoting water conservation, afforestation, and land development projects.
